title: abuse-detection finding
description: The WAF/Impart seam. Each abuse-detector finding is appended to abuse/YYYY-MM-DD/findings.jsonl in EXACTLY this shape (allow-list, additionalProperties false). A later enforcement phase reads findings.jsonl to add client_ip to a WAF IP-set and/or hand IP+UA to Impart.security. This file is documentation of the seam a downstream phase consumes — it is NOT read at runtime by the handler (buildFinding in lib/finding.mjs is the sole writer and enforces the same field set in code).

rule.description: Which detection fired (Q1 sustained_activity / Q2 rate_outlier).

client_ip.description: Offending source IP (the primary block key; attackers rotate UA more than IP).

user_agents.description: Distinct User-Agent(s) seen for this IP (capped, length-bounded — nothing unbounded leaks into email/JSONL, T-41-07).

count.description: Request count over the window (Q1) or peak requests-per-5min (Q2).

peak_5min.description: Peak requests in any single 5-minute bucket (Q2; 0 for Q1).

top_paths.description: Most-frequent request paths for this IP (capped, length-bounded).
